title: A photorealistic candid photograph taken
prompt:
A photorealistic candid photograph taken at a Japanese beach on a summer day, vertical 9:16 composition.

Two adult Japanese women, approximately 25–27 years old, are sitting on a beach towel spread over the sand, resting and chatting together. Both have naturally Japanese facial features, but their appearances are clearly distinct from one another.

Main woman: approximately 25 years old, with a small oval face, soft Japanese facial features, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, naturally fair skin, and long black hair reaching her chest, loosely tied into a low ponytail. A few fine strands of hair around her cheeks are gently moved by the sea breeze.

She wears a cobalt-blue two-piece bikini with a minimalist sporty design, featuring a square-neck top and mid-rise bottoms, made from realistic matte-textured swimwear fabric. Beside her lies a loose white linen shirt that she has just taken off and placed on the towel.

She sits in a relaxed position, one leg comfortably extended across the sand while the other is slightly bent. One hand supports her from behind, and her torso naturally turns toward her friend as they talk. She does not adjust her body for the camera and is not posing in any way.

Second woman: approximately 27 years old, with a slightly smaller round face, dark brown eyes, and shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair with gentle waves and Japanese-style wispy bangs.

She wears an ivory-cream one-piece swimsuit with a simple square neckline, paired with a pale blue sarong loosely tied around her hips. She sits angled toward her friend, with both legs resting naturally to one side. One hand holds a cold bottle of water while the other rests on the towel for support. She is listening to her friend and smiling softly.

The two women are simply chatting and relaxing, like an ordinary everyday moment someone might casually notice while walking along the beach. Neither woman looks toward the camera.

The camera is tightly zoomed in on the subjects: the photographer is actually standing approximately 10–15 meters away but uses a 135–200mm telephoto lens with tight zoom, making both women appear large in the image. Together, they occupy approximately 75–80% of the frame height. The composition focuses primarily on them, showing them from head to near their feet so that their faces, swimwear, and natural body proportions remain clearly visible.

The camera uses a slightly frontal three-quarter angle, positioned approximately at seated torso height. Telephoto compression visually pulls the background closer, creating the impression of distant observation even though the subjects appear very large within the frame.

Along the extreme left edge and lower corner, only a small portion of another beachgoer’s shoulder and the edge of a beach bag appear heavily out of focus, creating the impression that the photographer is zooming through a crowd. The foreground blur should not obscure too much of either subject.

Behind them are bright sand, blue ocean water, several beach umbrellas, and other adult beachgoers relaxing in the distance, all naturally softened by shallow depth of field. Summer sunlight reflected from the sand creates soft illumination across their skin, while a gentle breeze moves only a few loose strands of hair.
